description: This file initializes and renders the main React application component into the DOM. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App inside a StrictMode to the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to manage rendering of React components in the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
